\n \n \n Critics Consensus\n \n

Animated with infectious energy and vibrant colors, KPop Demon Hunters is jaunty family entertainment with a terrific soundtrack to boot.

\n Read Critics Reviews\n
\n \n\n \n
\n \n\n \n
\n \n \n Audience Says\n \n

With undeniable catchy tunes that \u2018hit the spot\u2019, KPop Demon Hunters is pure bubble gum for the brain: fun, sweet, synthetic joy that sticks with you all day.

\n Synopsis\n When they aren't selling out stadiums, Kpop superstars Rumi, Mira and Zoey use their secret identities as badass demon hunters to protect their fans from an ever-present supernatural threat. Together, they must face their biggest enemy yet -- an irresistible rival boy band of demons in disguise.\n
